newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Davids share value gobbled up on write-down.
newsitem.headline: Davids share value gobbled up on write-down.

text.p: Shares in grocery retailer and wholesaler Davids Ltd fell further on Thursday following the announcement of a A$262 million abnormal write-down on Wednesday.
At 10.45 a.m. (0045 GMT), Davids shares were 10 cents or 10 percent down at 90 cents, with almost one million shares traded.

Davids shares are now at a record low since their listing in June 1994. The shares have fallen about 19 percent over the past two days and about 50 percent since the end of last year as investors reassess the group after an recent expansion.
Brokers said the group's market share in the grocery wholesale sector was threatened by the entry of bigger grocery retailer Woolworths Ltd earlier this year.
